plugins.name: memstead
plugins.description: Install expertise into your agent. The Memstead plugin for Claude Code: the MCP tools for reading and writing typed, schema-validated markdown knowledge graphs, plus skills for setup, interview, bulk ingest, recall, sync/verify, and graph upkeep. A session that is already running picks the new skills up only after /reload-plugins or a restart; then run /setup once per workspace. Or just talk to Claude; the MCP tools need no slash command.
